attempted_claim: Let M_Davis be the Davis closed orientable arithmetic hyperbolic 4-manifold and M16 the Conder-MacLachlan closed orientable arithmetic hyperbolic 4-manifold with chi=16 from the [5,3,3,3] Coxeter group, with Chern-Gauss-Bonnet volumes Vol=4*pi^2*chi/3, so the pair has distinct certified volumes. Prove or disprove that their Mostow-rigidity length spectra are separated, namely that sys(M16) < sys(M_Davis) with disjoint two-sided intervals sys(M16) <= s0 < s1 <= sys(M_Davis) for explicit constants s0 < s1 certified by explicit closed geodesics and word-length lower bounds in the two Coxeter presentations. A complete answer must either certify both closed arithmetic structures with exact chi and volumes plus the disjoint systole intervals, or prove overlapping or reversed length bounds (exhibiting a short geodesic in M_Davis at or below the M16 upper bound, or a lower bound on sys(M16) at or above the M_Davis lower bound) refuting the claimed separation.
claim_type: two-sided systole separation with disjoint intervals
decisive_failure: No explicit torsion-free subgroup presentations or kernels for the Davis manifold or the M16 manifold were available in-lane, so no computed ambient-Coexeter-group word could be transferred to a certified manifold systole bound; the Chiswell and census computations remain ambient-group facts only and cannot support any claim about the named pair.
